blocks.title: Operating model
blocks.text: ADI describes its offerings as analog, digital, and software solutions. It sells products globally through direct sales, third-party distributors, independent sales representatives, and its website.

evidence.quote: analog, digital, and software solutions

blocks.title: Manufacturing and supply chain
blocks.text: ADI describes a hybrid manufacturing and supply-chain network that uses partners around the world.

evidence.quote: We leverage our relationships with partners all over the world

blocks.title: Product areas
blocks.text: ADI identifies analog and mixed-signal devices, power management, radio frequency offerings, edge processors, and sensors among its solution areas.

evidence.quote: analog and mixed-signal devices, power management, radio frequency offerings, and edge processors and sensors

blocks.title: Example application
blocks.text: ADI describes field instruments that combine sensing, actuation, processing, and communications to convert real-world signals such as temperature, level, flow, and pressure into data and insights.

evidence.quote: converting real-world signals such as temperature, level, flow, and pressure into actionable data and insights

blocks.title: Reported demand drivers
blocks.text: ADI attributed revenue growth to broad-based end-market demand; it reported the highest Industrial growth in test equipment and aerospace and defense, and said Communications growth was strongest in data center, driven by AI-related infrastructure investments.

evidence.quote: The strongest growth within Communications came from the data center sub-market, driven by artificial intelligence-related infrastructure investments.

blocks.text: Management said gross-margin percentage increased year over year primarily due to higher manufacturing fixed-cost utilization from increased customer demand and favorable product mix.

blocks.title: Demand and supply risks
blocks.text: The filing identifies changes in semiconductor demand, distributor performance, manufacturing delays, product and raw-material availability, and supply-chain disruptions as factors that could cause actual results to differ materially.

evidence.quote: changes in demand for semiconductor products; performance of independent distributors; manufacturing delays, product and raw materials availability and supply chain disruptions

blocks.title: Cybersecurity risk
blocks.text: ADI disclosed a June 2026 cybersecurity incident involving exfiltration of files from certain affected systems; its investigation into the nature and scope of the information remained ongoing.

evidence.quote: some of which resulted in the exfiltration of files from certain affected systems

blocks.title: Tax contingency
blocks.text: ADI disclosed an IRS assessment related to fiscal 2018 and fiscal 2019 transfer-pricing arrangements. The company said it disagrees and is preparing an appeal; an adverse outcome could materially affect future income tax expense and net earnings.

evidence.quote: Should the IRS ultimately prevail regarding its assessments for fiscal 2018 and fiscal 2019, such a resolution, along with any potential impact on subsequent fiscal years, could have a material adverse effect
